title: Arrest by National High-Tech Crime Unit

tellings.quote: I'm Jeff Donsson from the National High-Tech Crime Unit. You're under arrest for computer misuse.

plain: The British hacker Gary McKinnon, who says he broke into NASA and US military computers and found signs of a secret space programme, says that in 2002 an officer came to him in London and said: "I'm Jeff Donsson from the National High-Tech Crime Unit. You're under arrest for computer misuse." The National High-Tech Crime Unit was a British police squad for computer crime, and McKinnon tells Michels the arrest as something he lived through.
